skills.name: Composite - Drop liquid from a container onto a surface or object
skills.description: Drop liquid from a container onto a surface or object

steps.activity: Determine the location on the drop_target to drop the liquid_to_drop from the container
Align the container opening with the determined location on the drop_target
Press the container to release a few drops of the liquid_to_drop through the container opening on the drop_target

examples: Lubricate a nail gun by putting a few drops of lubricant through the nail gun head opening
